name: coinpaprika-mcp
description: CoinPaprika (market data): search_symbols. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Coins and tokens matching the query; symbol is CoinPaprika's coin id (btc-bitcoin), the ticker symbol is in raw.symbol. The API returns at most `limit` matches and has no paging, so there is no next page.
